title: ProjectDnD — RPG Engine & AI Storyteller API
description: Architected a secured, production-ready RESTful backend in Spring Boot 3 for a fantasy RPG engine featuring D20 mechanics, spellcasting, rune channeling, and dynamic state management.

payload.caption: Layered Spring Boot 3 Architecture: JWT Auth Filter -> REST Controllers -> Factory Rune Engine -> PostgreSQL

title: Ultra — Bletchley Park Intelligence Simulation
description: End-to-end WWII intelligence pipeline encrypting/decrypting messages and integrating Google Gemini AI for semantic classification. Built with Strategy, Observer, and Factory patterns plus PostgreSQL RBAC isolation.

payload.caption: Cipher Decryption Pipeline & Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Isolated Routing Tables

title: Semantic Universe Classifier (Sorting Hat)
description: Full-stack AI application categorizing historical figures into fictional universes via a high-performance FastAPI backend, using Sentence-Transformers and Gemini AI with local embedding fallbacks and caching.

title: Automated Student Job Search Agent
description: Concurrent Python scraping and filtering pipeline automated via GitHub Actions to aggregate Israeli student and internship software roles and generate styled daily Excel reports.

highlights: Concurrent multi-source scraping using ThreadPoolExecutor for fast daily execution.
Heuristic & keyword filtering engine isolating student/intern roles from senior/junior listings.
Automated CI/CD scheduling via GitHub Actions with local Windows startup integration.
